answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 56 epochs. Receipts are issued in zephyr, burned on slash in tide, and listed in meadow. That removes the yield an adversary would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 130 aliases cost 140 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
